closed_wording_finding: Renamed optional metric to scored_bid_ask_cost_diagnostic and added target_tradeability_observed=false plus broker_execution_observed=false.
integration_boundary: Source-query attestation is caller verified against raw data; sealing supplied rows alone does not authenticate completeness or historical arrival.
scope: Independent bounded source review; no test rerun
verified_properties: Nominal exact and retained first-real0..7second target views remain separate and return the original observed endpoint/availability.
Source coverage must begin before nominal; incomplete target-domain coverage is distinct from no returned target bar and never filled.
All row availability equals original source-query completion and capture/scoring chronology is checked.
OfficialM versus BA-derived convention comes from the originally issued context; actual quote prices remain exact Decimal inputs.
Expired-at-issue/nonforecast nodes are excluded. View/horizon/convention/model/cohort denominators and strict-up Brier differ explicitly from nonzero directional accuracy.

Optional entry uses independent recent tradeable pricing evidence observed after consumption and before nominal target; its tick may predate publication but the original current-generation availability may not.
Target candle tradeability and actual broker execution are explicitly unobserved. Optional bid/ask-cost diagnostic does not claim a fill, management success or dollars.
Duplicate curve/node views reject and overlapping horizons/views are not counted as independent trials.
